chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurara and one other, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:
When he copulates for the second time before he has expiated, so upon him is another expiation.
He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no differing in this'.

key_terms.زَهْر: Zihar (likening the wife to the mother)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man has intercourse with his wife after Zihar but before completing the expiation?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that if a man engages in sexual intercourse with his wife before completing the expiation for Zihar, a second expiation becomes obligatory, a ruling the Imam confirms is free from scholarly dispute. This underscores the strictness of the Zihar penalty in Shia jurisprudence, where the act of intercourse does not nullify the initial sin but rather adds to the required atonement. The certainty expressed ('la fi hadha ikhtilaf') highlights the consensus among early scholars on this specific procedural detail.
